## Checked

- [ ] `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .` are clean
- [ ] Changed output shows up in a golden file diff, and the diff is what I meant
- [ ] A new or changed rule: near misses in its fixture, and the real-world corpus rerun (`docs/real-world.md`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased, README or `docs/how-it-works.md` if behavior changed
